description: Test script for generating and comparing IDL differences in WebKit bindings, using unittest framework.

classes.name: TestGenerateIDLDiff
classes.description: Unit test class for testing IDL diff generation and comparison.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the diff object by loading old and new IDL JSON files and computing their interface differences.

methods.name: test_deleted_interface
methods.description: Tests detection of a deleted interface in the diff.

methods.name: test_added_interface
methods.description: Tests detection of an added interface in the diff.

methods.name: test_changed_interface
methods.description: Tests detection of a changed interface in the diff.

methods.name: test_unchanged_interface
methods.description: Tests detection of an unchanged interface in the diff.

methods.name: test_unchanged_consts
methods.description: Verifies constants within an interface remain unchanged.

methods.name: test_changed_attribute
methods.description: Checks detection of attribute changes within an interface.

methods.name: test_changed_operation
methods.description: Checks detection of operation (method) changes within an interface.
